setup.tagline: Harvesting olives is hard work. Keeping track of it shouldn't be.
setup.intro: Log field work in seconds, then follow your olive oil production year by year. Everything is stored on this device and works without signal.
setup.unitsTitle: How do you pack your olives?
setup.unitsHelp: Choose the units you use and pick your default. The weight is optional; the app will learn it from your mill extractions.
setup.fieldsHelp: Optional. With tree counts the app shows how many trees are left in each field.
setup.noFields: No fields yet. You can add them later in Settings.
setup.saveFailed: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.
setup.notSecure: This address doesn't start with https, so the app can't work offline or be added to the home screen. Everything else works. Ask the person who set it up to give you the https address.

today.title: What did you do today?
today.fieldFinishedHelp: Close this field for the year, even if trees are left.
today.seasonFieldYield: {{field}} this year: {{value}} per tree in the field

inputKind.done: Only whether the field is done

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Only on this phone. Each person can choose their own.
settings.labourHelp: Record workers and hours for each task.
settings.importFailed: Could not read this file. Choose a HarvestLog backup (.json) file.
settings.importConfirm: Restoring adds the farm from the file to this device and switches to it. Continue?
settings.storageNote: Your data is stored on this device. Export a backup regularly until server sync is available.
settings.storageNoteServer: Everything is saved on the server, which keeps daily backups. You can also export a copy of this grove.
settings.taxPercent: Tax estimate (% of a profit, optional)
settings.seasonStartHelp: A year holds all the work that leads to its oil: from spring work to the end of the harvest and the last mill visit (until the end of February when it starts in March). Money is always counted per calendar year.

summary.people: Who can see and change what
summary.dataOwner: Backup copy, accounts on this server

oil.noExtractions: No mill extractions this year yet.

extraction.title: Mill extraction
extraction.chargesHelp: What the mill kept in oil instead of money. Set a usual % in Settings to fill these in for you.
extraction.storedTooMuch: More oil is stored than the net oil. Lower the amounts under “Where the oil went”.
extraction.harvestHelp: Tick the harvest days whose olives went to the mill this time. Use “Part” if only some of a day’s olives went.
extraction.noHarvest: No harvest days are waiting for the mill.
extraction.nothingToSave: Enter the kg of olives and oil first.

tx.noStock: There is no oil in stock to sell.
tx.tooMuch: Only {{kg}} kg of this oil in stock.
tx.saleNothingToSave: Enter the kg and the price first.
tx.untrackedHelp: The app has no extractions for {{season}}, so this sale counts as income but does not reduce the oil in stock. If you enter that year’s extractions later, the sale will be taken from its stock automatically.

about.fields: How the fields performed each year. Darker cells mean more, so good and poor years stand out.
about.seasons: Each year’s totals. Choose what the chart shows.
about.yield: The yield of each mill visit, by date. Use it to see when the olives give the most oil.
about.money: Expenses and income of each calendar year, set against the oil of the same year.
about.records: Your all-time bests, and your numbers put another way.
about.year: How the year is going so far, and how it compares with other years.

empty.fields: Log harvests (and mill extractions) to compare your fields.
empty.seasons: Add a mill extraction to see the year’s totals.
empty.yield: Add mill extractions with olive and oil kg to see the yield.
empty.money: Add expenses or sales, or a mill extraction, to see the cost of your oil.
empty.records: Log harvests and productions to start setting records.
empty.year: Nothing logged this year yet. Log some work or a production to see how the year is going.

reports.fieldsNote: Oil per field is an estimate: each mill visit is split between the fields that went into it by the weight of their olives. “Per tree” uses the trees you entered as harvested, or all the field’s trees if you didn’t enter any. Tap a cell for details.
reports.yieldNote: Choose up to three years. Tap a point for its date, yield and acidity.
reports.moneyNote: Cost per kg = expenses ÷ net oil. Break-even price = the price per kg at which selling all the oil covers the expenses left after other income (subsidies etc.).
reports.fieldCellNoOil: {{field}} · {{season}}: {{units}} from {{trees}} trees, not taken to the mill yet

year.treesOf: {{harvested}} of the {{total}} trees in your fields
year.noTreeCounts: Add how many trees each field has (Settings) to see how far you are.
year.chartTitle: How the year is coming along
year.nothingYet: Nothing yet for this, this year or in other years.
year.unknownWeight: We don't know yet what {{units}} weigh. The first weigh-in will tell, or set roughly how many kg they are in Settings.

account.createHelp: This is the first account on this server. You will use this name and password to sign in on every phone or computer. The data already on this device will be saved on the server.
account.signInHelp: Sign in to see and log your grove’s work.
account.usernameHelp: Letters and numbers, e.g. your first name. No spaces.
account.errorTooMany: Too many wrong tries. Please try again in 15 minutes.
account.errorShort_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
account.errorShort_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
account.errorUsername: Use 2–40 letters or numbers, with no spaces.
account.errorRepeat: The two passwords are not the same.
account.errorAlreadySetUp: The administrator account already exists. Please sign in.
account.errorOffline: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
account.errorServer: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
account.title: Account
account.offline_one: No connection: {{count}} change will be sent when there is signal.
account.offline_other: No connection: {{count}} changes will be sent when there is signal.
account.syncError: Could not sync. It will try again shortly.
account.synced: Everything is saved on the server (last sync {{time}}).
account.signOutHelp: Your data stays on the server; it is removed from this device until you sign in again.
account.signOutPending_one: {{count}} change has not reached the server and will be lost.
account.signOutPending_other: {{count}} changes have not reached the server and will be lost.
account.loadingHelp: The first time on a new phone this can take a little while. Please keep the app open.
account.loadFailedTitle: Your data could not be loaded
account.loadFailedHelp: Check that the phone has internet, then try again. If it keeps failing, ask the person who set up the server.
account.groveRemoveHelp: Remove the grove “{{name}}”? It has no data, so nothing is lost. It is removed from the server and every device.
account.groveNotEmpty: This grove holds data, so it cannot be removed.
account.noGroveTitle: You are not in a grove yet
account.noGroveHelp: Ask the grove’s administrator to add you. Then open the app again.
account.newPasswordHelp: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own; only you will know it.
account.errorSameAsTemporary: Choose a password different from the temporary one.

users.title: People
users.help: Who can use this grove, and what each person may see and change.
users.adminHelp: Administrators can see and change everything, and manage people.

presetHelp.worker: Logs field work in Today and the Journal. Sees nothing about oil or money.
presetHelp.family: Logs work and oil, sees money and reports. Cannot change money or settings.
presetHelp.accountant: Sees oil, money and reports. Cannot change anything.

users.temporaryHelp: Pick any password, or keep the suggested one. They will choose their own when they first sign in.
users.ownGrove: Starts their own grove (their own administrator)
users.ownGroveHelp: They will set up a new grove of their own and will not see this one.
users.removeHelp: {{name}} will no longer see this grove. If it was their only grove, their account is deleted and the username is free again. What they logged stays.
users.handOverHelp: They sign in at this same address and then choose their own password.
users.handOverOwnGrove: They sign in at this same address, choose their own password and set up their grove.
users.errorTaken: That username is already used. Choose another.
users.errorLastAdmin: The grove needs at least one administrator.
users.errorOwner: The owner always stays an administrator.
users.errorNotAllowed: Only an administrator of this grove can do this.
users.errorAlreadyMember: This person is already in the grove. Use Change next to their name.
users.existingHelp: They already had an account, so they keep their own password. They will see this grove the next time the app syncs.

serverAccounts.title: Accounts on this server
serverAccounts.help: As the owner of this installation you can help anyone: give them a new temporary password or delete their account. You do not see what is in other people's groves.
serverAccounts.onlyYou: Nobody else has an account yet.
serverAccounts.waitingForGrove: has not set up their grove yet
serverAccounts.deleteHelp: Delete {{name}}'s account? They are signed out and the username can be used again. What they logged in shared groves stays.
serverAccounts.deleteGroves_one: Delete {{name}}'s account? Their grove, which nobody else uses, is deleted too, with everything in it. This cannot be undone (only from the server's daily backups).
serverAccounts.deleteGroves_other: Delete {{name}}'s account? {{count}} groves that nobody else uses are deleted too, with everything in them. This cannot be undone (only from the server's daily backups).
serverAccounts.resetHelp: They are signed out on all devices and choose their own password at the next sign-in.
serverAccounts.errorOnlyAdmin: They are the only administrator of a grove other people use. Ask them to make someone else administrator first.

shortfall.title: Oil would be missing
shortfall.help: After this change, more oil would have been sold or moved out than there is:
shortfall.fix: Check the sale or transfer of that season and place, or the production's charges and storage, so the numbers match the receipts.
shortfall.noteTitle: More oil was sold or moved out than there is:

draft.kept: Your unsaved entry is kept. It will be here when you come back.

compare.title: Put another way
compare.note: Rough figures, to give you a picture. Family: about 12 kg of oil per person a year, as people eat in Greece. Salad: 2 tablespoons of oil. Trees in a row: 7 metres apart.

say.oilWeight: The oil you made {{when}} weighs as much as {{thing}}.
say.oliveWeight: The olives you picked {{when}} weigh as much as {{thing}}.
say.treeLine: The trees you harvested {{when}}, lined up, stretch as far as {{thing}}.
say.family: The oil you made {{when}} keeps a family of four in oil for {{count}} years.
say.familyMonths: The oil you made {{when}} keeps a family of four in oil for {{count}} months.
say.salads: The oil you made {{when}} is enough for about {{count}} Greek salads.
say.oilPerTree: On average, each of your trees filled {{thing}} with oil {{when}}.
say.oilPerTreeAll: On average, each of your trees fills {{thing}} with oil a year.
say.olivesPerLitre: It took about {{count}} kg of olives to make a litre of oil {{when}}.
say.olivesPerLitreAll: On average, a litre of your oil takes about {{count}} kg of olives.
say.treeLineFarm: Your {{trees}} trees, lined up, stretch as far as {{thing}}.
